title: Movement
info: Moving your body keeps you strong and can put you in a good mood.
Walking, playing, dancing, and sports all count. Rest matters too.

options: Holding your breath as a sport

questions.q: You have to be the fastest person to benefit from moving.
questions.explain: Any amount of play and movement helps. You do not need to win.
